sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits a recursively defined list to be a well-formed infinite value, with only demanded cells evaluated.
sketches.resonance: It continues because no one asks for the whole of it at once.

sketches.mechanism: With the occurs check disabled, unification can bind a variable to a term containing that same variable, creating a cyclic rational tree.
sketches.resonance: Agreement becomes a loop: the self is accepted only by containing itself forever.

sketches.mechanism: A linked process propagates a non-normal exit signal to its linked process unless it is explicitly trapping exits.
sketches.resonance: The bond makes survival shared; one violent ending reaches the other before waiting can finish.
sketches.draft:
-module(a).
-export([x/0]).

x() ->
    spawn_link(fun() -> exit(kill) end),
    receive after infinity -> ok end.
